items.title: Amendment to the Special Act on the Prevention of Loss Caused by Telecommunications-based Financial Fraud and Refund for Loss
items.summary: The Amendment to the Special Act strengthens the framework for preventing telecommunications-based financial fraud and curbing the spread of damage. With the rapid advancement of information and communications technologies, including artificial intelligence and deepfake technologies, voice phishing schemes have become increasingly sophisticated and diversified, resulting in a sharp rise in the scale of damage to…

items.title: Amendment to the Act on Electronic Registration of Stocks and Bonds
items.summary: The amendments establish an issuance and distribution framework for Security Tokens to facilitate fractional investment in real estate, music copyrights, fine art, and other assets. In light of the rapid development of online and digital trading platforms, the amendments aim to invigorate the over-the-counter (OTC) market by creating a distribution environment in which atypical securities representing various assets…

items.title: Amendment to the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety
items.summary: The amended Framework Act provides the legal basis for establishing a Central Joint Disaster Victim Support Center to assist victims of large-scale disasters and their families, and for conducting surveys assessing disaster recovery levels. The head of the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters may establish and operate a Central Joint Disaster Victim Support Center—such as in the cases of the…

items.title: Amendment to the Special Act on the Redevelopment and Support of Aging Planed Cities
items.summary: The amendment supports the expedited implementation of redevelopment projects aimed at the comprehensive and systematic redevelopment of aging planned cities. Following the enactment (December 26, 2023) and enforcement (April 27, 2024) of the Special Act, redevelopment projects have been underway in first-generation new towns and other aging planned cities.

items.title: Amendment to the Aviation and Railway Accident Investigation Act
items.summary: The amended Act transfers the Aviation and Railway Accident Investigation Board from under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport to under the Office of the Prime Minister. This legislative measure reflects concerns raised that officials who had been involved in, or were responsible for, matters related to the causes of aviation and railway accidents—such as the December 29 passenger aircraft…

items.title: Amendment to the Child Welfare Act
items.summary: The amendment expands the scope of child-related institutions subject to employment restrictions for individuals with prior child abuse convictions to include alternative education institutions registered with the superintendent of education of a Metropolitan City or a Province pursuant to the Act on Alternative Educational Institution. To prevent the recurrence of child abuse-related deaths, the Minister of Health…

items.title: <2> Amendments to the Act on the Prevention of and Countermeasures against Agricultural and Fishery Disasters and the Agricultural and Fishery Disaster Insurance Act
items.summary: The amendment to the Act on the Prevention of and Countermeasures against Agricultural and Fishery Disasters centers on enabling the government to compensate for production costs incurred before a disaster occurs. Current disaster-support standards have been criticized for failing to reflect actual losses.

items.title: Act on Supporting Structural Reform of Private Universities*
items.summary: The Act on Supporting Structural Reform of Private Universities aims to provide systematic support for the restructuring of private universities and incorporated educational foundations. Closures of local private universities due to financial distress have repercussions that extend far beyond the impacts on students and faculty, including diminished regional research capacity and economic impact to local communities.

items.title: Amendment to the Trucking Transport Business Act
items.summary: The approved amendment reintroduces the Safe Trucking Freight Rates system for a three-year sunset period from Jan. 1, 2026 to Dec.

items.title: Act on the Promotion and Support of Village Enterprises*
items.summary: The approved Act clarifies the legal basis for the financial and administrative support necessary for the establishment and operation of village enterprises and establishes grounds for devising comprehensive plans to support them in a systematic manner. Village enterprise promotion initiatives aim to enable area residents to utilize local resources to generate income and jobs while voluntarily addressing local…

bills.summary: The plenary approved measures covering 국회사무처는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 정보주체의 개인정보 및 권익을 보호하고, 개인정보와 관련한 정보주체의 고충을 원활하게 처리할 수 있도록 다음과 같은 개인정보 처리방침을 두고 있습니다.; 소관업무 : 개인정보 침해사실 신고, 상담신청; 홈페이지 : privacy.kisa.or.kr.

items.title: Second Supplementary Budget and Fund Management Plan Adjustment for FY2025
items.summary: The 2nd Supplementary Budget and Fund Management Plan Adjustment for FY2025 aims to promote economic revitalization—by boosting consumption and investment—and to stabilize people's livelihoods, thus facilitating a swift recovery from the economic challenges currently affecting households and the broader economy. The National Assembly increased the government's 30.55 trillion won proposal by a net 1.25 trillion won,…

items.title: Amendment to the Commercial Act
items.summary: The amendment expands the scope of directors’ duty of loyalty to ‘the company and shareholders’ from ‘the company’ alone, requiring directors to protect the interests of all shareholders in the performance of their duties and to treat them equitably. By ensuring that directors protect not only majority but also minority shareholders in processes such as mergers and spin-offs, the amendment aims to address the…

items.title: Amendment to the Immigration Act
items.summary: The amended Act establishes the legal basis for the foreign seasonal worker program to support its stable and systematic operation. Prior to amendment, the program was operated under the Enforcement Decree of the Act and internal guidelines, namely the Basic Plan for the Foreign Seasonal Worker Program.

items.title: Amendment to the Martial Law Act
items.summary: The amendment prohibits obstruction of entry by lawmakers and National Assembly staff into the Assembly compound and meetings while banning entry into the Assembly compound by military personnel, police, and intelligence/security officials without the Speaker’s authorization. The amendment aims to strengthen democratic oversight of martial law and to guarantee lawmakers’ participation in deliberations on motions…

items.title: Act on the Transition and Support of the Hanwoo Industry in Response to Carbon Neutrality
items.summary: The approved Act promotes a shift toward low-emissions livestock practices and supports the sound development of the Hanwoo (Korean cattle) industry. The new Act mandates that the government establish and implement a comprehensive plan for the development of the Hanwoo industry every five years, after which metropolitan governments must formulate and carry out implementation plans accordingly.

items.title: Amendment to the Act on Promotion of Sports for All
items.summary: The amendment aims to open up sports facilities in elementary, middle, and high schools for use by area residents and exempt school principals from civil liability in the case of accidents that occur during such use. Currently, public access to school sports facilities has been limited because schools often bear the burden of repair costs in the event of facility damage and principals face legal liability for…

bills.title: Plenary passes 46 agenda items including 1st Supplementary Budget for FY2025
bills.summary: The plenary approved measures covering 국회사무처는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 정보주체의 개인정보 및 권익을 보호하고, 개인정보와 관련한 정보주체의 고충을 원활하게 처리할 수 있도록 다음과 같은 개인정보 처리방침을 두고 있습니다.; 소관업무 : 개인정보 침해사실 신고, 상담신청; 홈페이지 : privacy.kisa.or.kr.

items.title: First Supplementary Budget for FY2025 and Fund Management Plan
items.summary: The 1st Supplementary Budget and Fund Management Plan for FY2025 focuses on disaster response, support for trade and artificial intelligence, and economic recovery for the public. The National Assembly increased the government’s supplementary budget proposal of 12.16 trillion won to 13.78 trillion won.

items.title: Amendment to the Special Act on Support for Jeonse Fraud Victims and Housing Stabilization
items.summary: The amendment extends the validity of the current Special Act on jeonse fraud victims—which provides special measures on auctions, public sales, and tax collection to tenants who were victimized by jeonse fraud— by two years until May 31, 2027. The extension aims to ensure that tenants at potential risk of victimization are protected, but the coverage is provided to those signing their first lease contract no later…

items.title: Act on Management of Real Estate Development Projects*
items.summary: The newly approved Act establishes a government-level management system to enhance the soundness and systematic oversight of real estate development projects, including those involving project financing. Under the Act, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may obtain information from developers on ▲ project notifications and submissions; ▲ statistical data; and ▲ management status; and build and operate…

items.title: Amendment to the Special Act on Underground Safety Management
items.summary: The amended Special Act strengthens oversight of areas at risk of ground subsidence by granting the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport the authority to conduct on-site inspections. Currently, central government agencies and provincial/municipal governments are authorized to conduct on-site inspections of underground facilities and surrounding ground conditions.

items.title: Amendment to the Act on Fostering and Supporting Women Scientists and Technicians
items.summary: The amendment mandates the continuous identification and dissemination of exemplary cases of public institutions’ promotion of their development and support of female scientists and engineers. Under the current law, the Minister of Science and ICT establishes a basic plan for fostering and supporting women employed in science and technology fields every five years, whilst central government agencies and local…

items.title: Amendment to the Special Act on the Development of Traditional Markets and Shopping Districts
items.summary: The amended Special Act requires the Small Enterprise and Market Service to establish a reporting center for preventing the fraudulent circulation of Onnuri gift certificates. A reward review committee shall be set up within the Small Enterprise and Market Service to deliberate on payment of rewards.

items.title: Amendment to the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety
items.summary: The amendment strengthens support for residents, small business owners, and others affected by recent large-scale wildfires in North and South Gyeongsang Provinces and Ulsan Metropolitan City. Presently, the law provides only for income stabilization support and facility restoration following disasters.

items.title: <9> Amendment to the Special Act on Local Autonomy and Decentralization, and Balanced Regional Development; and Amendment to the Special Act on Support for Depopulation Regions
items.summary: The two amendments introduce a definition for “regions of depopulation concern,” enabling the establishment of plans comparable to those for officially designated depopulation regions, and laying the foundation for support via local subsidies. Under the amendments, a region of depopulation concern is defined as a city, county, or district—excluding those already designated as depopulation regions—whose population is…

items.title: Special Act on Remedies for Damages Caused by the December 29 Aviation Disaster and Assistance Therefor*
items.summary: The approved Special Act aims to commemorate the victims of the Jeju Air passenger plane crash that occurred on December 29, 2024 at Muan International Airport and to provide support for the victims, including assistance for their daily living needs and psychological stability. The Special Act enables the government to provide victims with living support payments and medical assistance and stipulates the provision…

items.title: Amendment to the Constitutional Court Act
items.summary: The amendment intends to clarify the authority of the Acting President to appoint Constitutional Court Justices and to ensure the continuity of the Court’s operations. Under the amendment, an Acting President — appointed due to the vacancy, incapacitation, or suspension of the President — may only appoint Constitutional Court Justices from among three justices selected by the National Assembly and three nominated by…

items.title: Amendments to five laws under the jurisdiction of the Gender Equality and Family Committee
items.summary: The bill removes “cases in which a person has been declared bankrupt and has not been reinstated” from the list of disqualification criteria for certain professions and businesses. The five laws are: the Act on the Prevention of Domestic Violence and Protection of Victims; the Marriage Brokers Business Management Act; the Child Care Support Act; the Framework Act on Youth; and the Youth Activity Promotion Act.

items.title: Amendment to the Broadcasting Act
items.summary: The amendment stipulates the collection of the TV license fee (KRW 2,500 per month) integrated into electricity bills to ensure a stable funding source for public broadcasting. Previously, the license fee had been collected separately from electricity bills following revision of the Enforcement Decree of the Broadcasting Act in July 2023.

bills.title: Plenary passes 32 agenda items including amendment to the Framework Act on Health and Medical Services
bills.summary: The plenary approved measures covering 국회사무처는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 정보주체의 개인정보 및 권익을 보호하고, 개인정보와 관련한 정보주체의 고충을 원활하게 처리할 수 있도록 다음과 같은 개인정보 처리방침을 두고 있습니다.; 소관업무 : 개인정보 침해사실 신고, 상담신청; 홈페이지 : privacy.kisa.or.kr.

items.title: Amendment to the Framework Act on Health and Medical Services
items.summary: The amendment provides for the establishment of a labor force projection committee to forecast the supply and demand of healthcare personnel by profession (e.g., doctors, nurses, pharmacists). Following the government’s decision to increase medical school enrollment quotas in 2024, social conflicts have emerged, underscoring the need for an objective and independent body to estimate the appropriate scale of…

items.title: Special Act on Compensation for Adverse Reactions to COVID-19 Vaccination*
items.summary: The approved Special Act stipulates provisions for compensation and support for individuals who suffered harm following receipt of a COVID-19 vaccination. The purpose of this Special Act is to reduce the financial burden on citizens who have experienced adverse reactions following COVID-19 vaccination and to enhance public trust in the vaccination process.

items.title: Amendment to the Child Care Support Act
items.summary: The amendment introduces a national certification system for childcare providers and a registration system for childcare service agencies. The national certification system for childcare providers allows the Minister of Gender Equality and Family to grant qualifications to individuals who have passed personality and aptitude assessments among those who completed designated training programs at certified institutions…

items.title: Amendment to the Protection of Children and Youth Against Sex Offenses
items.summary: The amendment stipulates that individuals who possess or view materials featuring child and/or adolescent sexual exploitation will be subject to criminal punishment, even if they merely possess or view such materials. At present, any person who purchases, knowingly possesses, or views materials featuring child or adolescent exploitation shall be sentenced to imprisonment for not less than one year.

items.title: ·<6> Amendments to the Framework Act on Gender Equality and the Sexual Violence Prevention and Victims Protection Act
items.summary: The amendments introduce protective measures for victims of sexual harassment and sexual violence that occur within government agencies and other public institutions. The heads of such institutions are now required to take appropriate measures — such as changes to the workplace or reassignment of duties for the victim or perpetrator — during the handling of a sexual harassment or sexual violence case.

items.title: Amendment to the Special Act on the Management of Intercity Transport in Metropolitan Areas
items.summary: The amendment expands the scope of the term “metropolitan area” to include cities with a population of 500,000 or more that are not currently designated as Special or Metropolitan Cities but serve as provincial capitals, along with their respective regions that share the same commuting zone. It also broadens the definition of metropolitan transportation facilities.

items.title: Synthetic Biology Promotion Act*
items.summary: The approved Act establishes the legal framework for fostering a synthetic biology ecosystem and lays the groundwork for Korea to play a leadership role in the bioeconomy era. Synthetic biology is a core technology in the digital bio field that integrates advanced digital technologies such as artificial intelligence and big data.

items.title: Amendment to the Fisheries Act
items.summary: The amendment allows for the removal of illegal and/or unlicensed fishing equipment and facilities—whose owners or users are unknown—without undertaking prior warning or notification procedures under the Administrative Vicarious Execution Act. This amendment responds to growing concerns about the negative impacts of illegally installed or abandoned fishing gear in the seas, which have been linked to the depletion of…

bills.summary: The plenary approved measures covering 국회사무처는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 정보주체의 개인정보 및 권익을 보호하고, 개인정보와 관련한 정보주체의 고충을 원활하게 처리할 수 있도록 다음과 같은 개인정보 처리방침을 두고 있습니다.; 소관업무 : 개인정보 침해사실 신고, 상담신청; 홈페이지 : privacy.kisa.or.kr.

items.title: Amendment to the National Pension Act
items.summary: The amendment raises the national pension contribution rate and income replacement rate, expands credits for childbirth and military service, and explicitly stipulates the government’s guarantee of pension payments. The contribution rate will increase from 9% to 13%, and the income replacement rate from 40% to 43%.

items.title: Amendment to the Criminal Act
items.summary: This amendment introduces penalties for acts that threaten public safety through weapons possession in public spaces. Under the amendment, individuals who, without justifiable reason, carry and openly display a dangerous weapon—one capable of causing harm to life or bodily safety—in public spaces such as roads and parks, or any area accessible to an unspecified or large number of people, thereby sowing fear or…

items.title: Amendment to the Passport Act
items.summary: The amendment introduces a provision that allows individuals under the age of 18 to apply for a passport without the consent of their legal guardian under certain circumstances. Under the current law, minors under 18 must obtain the consent of their legal guardian when applying for a passport.

items.title: Act on the Promotion of the Wellbeing Tourism Industry*
items.summary: The Act establishes the legal foundation for fostering the wellbeing tourism industry by integrating various sectors such as agriculture, forestry, and marine resources. The newly enacted bill defines wellbeing tourism as tourism activities aimed at restoring and enhancing health and improving quality of life through the use of wellbeing tourism resources such as natural landscapes, hot springs, and local cuisine.
